steps.text: Sunday 28th June 2026 Click Here | Click Here

operator_notes: This page lists bulletin PDFs — the newest is usually at the top, but some parishes put it at the bottom.
Point at this week's bulletin link (Download File / Parish News). Harvester picks the newest dated PDF each Sunday.
Do not worry if the filename or date in the link text changes every week.
do_not: Do not pin a dated filename in the selector (e.g. 14th_june_2026.pdf) — it breaks next week.
Do not pick GDPR, Gift Aid, or financial statement PDFs.
operator_notes_2026_08_09: 2026-08-09 fix: the recipe's own click selector violated its do_not rule above — it was pinned to the exact trained filename 'newsletter_280626oo.pdf' (28 June), so it matched only that one link every week and newest_dated scoring never ran across the real candidate set. This silently harvested a 6-week-stale bulletin while reporting outcome=ok. Selector generalised to a[href$='.pdf'].

2026-09-06: listing HTML has no PDF hrefs (JS). this-week file is /2026/09/newsletter_060926oo.pdf. predicted_dated_pdf rewrites DDMMYY and the WordPress /YYYY/MM/ folder. Do not print the listing (that was the 5-page fail).
